# Weft 1.0.12
- Preparation now uses expandable sections for company sign-in, project settings, requirements, and installation. Completed sections collapse and the next task opens; each section can be reopened. - Downloaded settings support common line endings and quotation marks while preserving existing settings if validation fails. - Running services that stop unexpectedly or fail health checks trigger an audible notification, including while Weft is open. Intentional stops and restarts do not trigger service-down alerts. - Successful builds with warnings are labeled clearly, with expandable warning details. Logs show when the project is running and passing health checks.
